neee2f6b21b.headline: Tawfiq Bakkar: “It is necessary to reconsider the Central Bank law to guarantee its independence from the government and Ministry of Finance”
neee2f6b21b.summary: Tawfiq Bakkar, former governor of Tunisia's central bank, urged reconsideration of the bank's law to guarantee its independence from government and finance ministry.
neee2f6b21b.why: Central bank independence is crucial for credible monetary policy and investor confidence in emerging markets like Tunisia.
